atomic_facts.fact: Tricolor Holdings, LLC filed a bankruptcy petition on September 10, 2025
The bankruptcy was a Chapter 7 case filed in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the Northern District of Texas
The court docket excerpt contains a notation that a case was discharged on 7/14/26 ('CASE DISCHARGED 7/14/26 PER DKT. 21')
The case discharged on July 14, 2026 was Tricolor Holdings' Chapter 7 bankruptcy case
Public sources describe Tricolor Holdings as a now-bankrupt investment company
The description of Tricolor Holdings as now-bankrupt is dated as of October 13, 2026
The bankruptcy filing record (Chapter 7 petition filed September 10, 2025) contradicts the claim that Tricolor Holdings has never filed for bankruptcy
Discharge records for Tricolor Holdings' own bankruptcy case contradict the claim that it never filed for bankruptcy
